name: Build and Release Obedor (ManualAI)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  build-executables:
    name: Build obedor on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            artifact_name: obedor-linux
            exe_ext: ""
          - os: windows-latest
            artifact_name: obedor-windows
            exe_ext: ".exe"
          - os: macos-latest
            artifact_name: obedor-macos
            exe_ext: ""
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11' 
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller
          
      - name: Build Executable with PyInstaller
        # src/main.py를 'obedor'라는 이름의 실행파일로 빌드
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --name obedor${{ matrix.exe_ext }} src/main.py
          
      - name: Prepare Release Artifacts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir release_package
          
          # 실행 파일 복사
          cp dist/obedor${{ matrix.exe_ext }} release_package/
          
          # 필수 문서 복사
          cp README.md release_package/
          cp LICENSE release_package/
          
          # 데이터 생성 스크립트 및 소스 포함 (사용자가 재생성 가능하도록)
          cp -r src release_package/
          
          # Zip 압축
          cd release_package
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" == "Windows" ]; then
            7z a ../${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip .
          else
            zip -r ../${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip .
          fi
          
      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}
          path: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip

  create-release:
    needs: build-executables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: v7.0-build-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Release v7.0 (Obedor) - Build ${{ github.run_number }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            obedor-linux/obedor-linux.zip
            obedor-windows/obedor-windows.zip
            obedor-macos/obedor-macos.zip

  build-docker:
    name: Build and Push Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          
      - name: Build and Push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v4
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/manualai:latest
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/manualai:v7.0
